comparison_tracks.description: Primary paired comparison of standard/core.md v0.2.0 against frozen provider-native baseline across engineering-credibility probes (SE1, SE2) and calibrated origin: real_work OSS tasks (RW5, RW6).
Per-model delta overlay ablation testing model-specific rules from gates/model_deltas.json layered on top of standard/core.md v0.2.0 across SE1, SE2, RW5, and RW6.
End-to-end comparison of standard/core.md v0.2.0 + per-model delta overlays against provider-native baseline across SE1, SE2, RW5, and RW6.

limits: Mixed suite combining two constructed engineering-credibility scenarios (SE1, SE2) with two pinned Nov 2026 public OSS origin: real_work scenarios (RW5, RW6); report constructed and real_work outcomes separately rather than pooling into a single real-work claim.
Focused on four target models (claude-opus-5-5, gpt-6.2-astra, gpt-6.2-sol, gemini-4-neon); models and lineage stages are not additional independent task scenarios.
Preserve benchmarks/pilot.json, benchmarks/pilot-v0.3.0.json, benchmarks/pilot-v0.4.0.json, W1-RW6, and all committed prior results unmodified.
Never substitute a different model without a new explicitly labelled experiment.
